title: Create Memory Health Dashboard service
acceptance_criteria: Pure function: aggregate_health_metrics(memory) -> dict with stale_decisions, coverage_gaps, growth_trends, quality_score
Uses existing get_stale_decisions and get_confidence_summary from knowledge_decay.py
Computes coverage gaps by analyzing decision topics vs project tech_stack
Returns quality_score as weighted average of decay scores
All functions < 50 lines, no side effects
